¿De dónde salen las piezas?: Where do the parts come from?
De las bibliotecas que ya configuraste e: From the libraries you already configured in KiCad. If a part is not there, the chat does not draw an invented symbol.
¿Y si el símbolo no trae huella?: What if the symbol has no footprint?
No se escribe sin ella. El chat busca en: It is not written without one. The chat looks in your libraries for a footprint with the same pad count and, if there are several, asks you which one.
Si vuelvo a pedir el circuito, ¿se dupli: If I ask for the circuit again, are the parts duplicated?
No. Una referencia que ya está con el mi: No. A reference that is already there with the same symbol is kept with its id and position. If that reference is already on the board, the chat does not redo the sheet.
Yes, on this computer, next to the settings. The sidebar lists them; you can open or delete them. They do not store the API key.
¿Por qué hay que cerrar el editor de esq: Why does the schematic editor have to be closed?
KiCad 10 no deja escribir el esquemático: KiCad 10 does not allow writing the schematic through the API. The plugin edits the `.kicad_sch` and keeps a copy in `.kicad-ia-backup/`. With the editor open, it does not write.
¿El chat actualiza la placa solo?: Does the chat update the board by itself?
No. Después del esquemático, en el edito: No. After the schematic, in the PCB editor you use F8: Tools → Update PCB from Schematic.
No. Lo enciendes en Ajustes, con Java 17: No. You turn it on in Settings, with Java 17 or later and the minimum fabrication widths. The proposal is applied when you confirm.
¿Colocar la placa certifica el diseño?: Does placing the board certify the design?
No. El informe es un prechequeo IPC Clas: No. The report is an IPC Class 2 pre-check. Validate only fixes what it can do safely.
